about: Independent verification of market events used as News Desk replay/regression examples (2026-11-16..24), done 2026-11-24 06:35-06:50 UTC. Each claim was checked against at least two sources other than Yahoo Finance where reachable; Yahoo values are listed for comparison only. Raw responses: docs/newsdesk/raw-2026-11-24/ (_index.json maps each file to its URL and retrieval time). verified: true = confirmed by >=2 independent sources; partial = the event happened but a figure, timing, date or wording differs (see note); false = the claim is wrong. Unreachable: Stooq (JavaScript bot challenge), Cboe CDN (403), CNBC quote API (403), S&P DJI site (error page). CME/COMEX settlements were not read directly: COMEX contract months are read through Yahoo's per-contract symbols and labelled as such. FRED had not yet published 11-23 for SP500/NASDAQCOM (nor 11-20 for NASDAQCOM/NASDAQ100) at retrieval.

events.note: Not a data error: xyz:COPPER is a perpetual priced off COMEX MARCH 2027 copper (HGH27) since its 11-12 roll; Yahoo HG=F is the DECEMBER 2026 front month (HGZ26). Like-for-like: compare xyz:COPPER with HGH27.CMX (or compare % changes, which agree). The same applies to oil: xyz:CL = WTI Jan 2027 (F7) and xyz:BRENTOIL = Brent Feb 2027 (G7) after their November rolls, while Yahoo CL=F/BZ=F follow the front month. Caveat: the HGH27 price is read via Yahoo's per-contract symbol (CME's own settlement page was not read).
